claims.exact_statement: For every nonconstant Boolean f and relevant coordinate i, with R=H(f)/I(f), child averages Hbar,Ibar, d_i=I_i(f), and Delta_iH=H(f)-Hbar, one has Hbar-R Ibar=R d_i-Delta_iH. Hence Delta_iH/d_i<R exposes a nonconstant physical child of ratio greater than R. Every descendant-critical f satisfies Delta_iH>=R I_i(f) for all i. A minimum-dimensional counterexample to H<=C I is tensor-prime and satisfies Delta_iH-CI_i(f)>=H(f)-CI(f)>0 for every i.
proof_dependencies: exact restriction identities for H and I
scope_exclusions: Does not prove a universal bound on the minimum step ratio
Does not make qualitative primitivity sufficient
